sub_class_5_v_formal_definition.sub_class_5_v_formal_definition: A SHIP-COMPLETE spec S1 experiences state drift Delta (per Codif 35 v0.3 cat 4 sub-class 1 sub-class f.i) that propagates to N>=11 downstream specs and requires >=5 mechanical version bumps across the S1 lineage to recover.
sub_class_5_v_distinguishing_properties: 1. LINEAGE-WIDE DISTRIBUTION: bumps are not concentrated in 1 spec but distributed across the spec's lineage
2. CODIFICATION EMERGENCE: the pattern requires codification (a 5.v carrier spec that documents the pattern), not just recovery
3. CROSS-MUSE VISIBILITY: the lineage spans multiple Muses' cite-back references
4. RATIFICATION-GATE SIGNIFICANT: sub-class 5.v triggers RATIFICATION gate cycle 14 W1 turn 1 v0.3 schema freeze

codif_22_v0_2_7_step_mechanical_bump_pro: 1. DETECT fabrication via 4-witness verification (W1 Glob + W2 Grep + W3 Read + W4 filesystem-stat) at all 3 dual-write paths
2. CLASSIFY fabrication into Codif 35 v0.3 trigger_code + sub-class
3. DOCUMENT fabrication in section 0a addendum (Athena T-AT-032 v0.1 precedent) or post-SHIP fold-in (Hera T-HE-041 v0.1 precedent) or v0.1.1 mechanical bump (this spec lineage)
4. MECHANICAL BUMP anchor spec to v{N+1} per Codif 22 v0.2 filename v{N+1} = spec_version v{N+1} strict alignment
5. DUAL-WRITE bumped spec to all 3 paths (canon + slot_strat + slot_leader) per Codif 31 v0.2 B.5.1.1
6. VERIFY 3-path MATCH post-bump (Codif 31 v0.2 B.5.1.1) with ACTUAL Get-FileHash + 0x0A trailing LF parity + JSON valid sidecar
7. CITE-BACK to all N downstream specs + CLOSE-OUT via Mnemosyne T-MN-013 v0.4 section 15.12 lineage ledger entry
